subject.title: fix(text): strip MiniMax marker from channel replies

question: Should this PR require an after-fix official MiniMax delivery demonstration, or should maintainers explicitly override that proof gate based on the focused tests and existing before-fix evidence?
rationale: The branch is an external message-delivery change, and neither unit tests nor Ollama non-regression output proves the corrected behavior on the affected official MiniMax transport.

options.title: Require official after-fix proof
options.body: Capture a redacted Telegram recording, transcript, terminal/live output, or logs from `minimax` or `minimax-portal` showing the marker absent after the fix.

options.title: Explicitly override the proof gate
options.body: Accept the focused stream tests and before-fix evidence as sufficient while knowingly owning the remaining official-provider delivery uncertainty.

recommendation.title: Require official after-fix proof
recommendation.body: Capture a redacted Telegram recording, transcript, terminal/live output, or logs from `minimax` or `minimax-portal` showing the marker absent after the fix.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned and supplied the current provider-boundary direction after stopping automerge.
